title: Asking for a Sunday or after-hours appointment

persona.name: Emily Chen
persona.style: polite but firm, works long shifts as a nurse

goals.goal: Ask for an appointment this Sunday morning for wrist pain; it's the only day you're free.
If Sunday isn't possible, ask for a weekday after seven in the evening.
If they offer anything, confirm the exact day and time back to them.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling to see if I can get an appointment for wrist pain.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file. Am I speaking with Maria?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: No, this is Emily Chen. Could I please check if you have me under my full name?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Sure. Could you provide your full name and date of birth?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I'll check for you.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: My full name is Emily Chen, and my date of birth is January 27, 1990. Could you please see if you have any appointments available this Sunday morning? That's the only time I'm free.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I'll check the schedule for you. But first, can you please spell your first and last name to make sure I have it correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's E-M-I-L-Y C-H-E-N. Could you please see if you have any appointments this Sunday morning?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like to use your phone number to look up your record? If so, please tell me the number you have on file with us. If you're not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again. Which would you prefer?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Let's stick with my name and date of birth for now. I just want to know if there's an appointment this Sunday morning for my wrist pain.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: To make sure I have your details right, could you please spell your first and last name one more time? And confirm your date of birth?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Then I'll check Sunday morning appointments for you.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: It's Emily Chen, E-M-I-L-Y C-H-E-N, and my date of birth is January 27, 1990. Do you have anything Sunday morning?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I have your phone number as three one four four six four two six six one and your date of birth is January twenty seventh nineteen ninety. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: That's not my phone number. The correct number is 805-555-0189. But yes, the date of birth is correct. Can you please check for Sunday morning now?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I can't find a matching record for you in our system. I'll connect you to our patient support team so they could help you schedule your appointment.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Please stay on the line.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Transferring you now. Thank you.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Okay, thanks for trying.
